formula: clamp(role_base + max(0, top_200_selection_score - 60) * 2100 + champion_bonus, role_min, role_max) * availability_multiplier
notes: Initial draft value buys full-season roster rights. No signing bonus. Balanced so $4M buys ~20 rounded stars, $2M buys ~14, $1M buys ~10 with booking reserve pressure.
Contract total is weekly rate multiplied by requested weeks, plus optional signing bonus.

formula: family_base + duration + intensity/risk/spectacle + production + medical, multiplied by booking_cost_multiplier
notes: Stipulation costs reflect fatigue/injury/spectacle, so cage/cell/war games cost more than singles.

formula: sum(revenue_streams) - venue_rent - production_floor - sum(segment_costs) - sum(appearance_fees) - medical_followup - penalties
notes: Post-show readout should separate gross revenue, total expenses, and net profit.
Starting budget comes from player choice, not hard-coded by brand.
Used only after initial draft. Contract length can vary; no signing bonus, no upfront bonus field.
